resources.title: Stiffness and Viscoelasticity of Adipose Tissue Decellularized Extracellular Matrix Hydrogels Influence Proliferation, Growth Pattern, Migration and Invasion of Breast Cancer Cells

paragraphs: Stiffness and Viscoelasticity of Adipose Tissue Decellularized Extracellular Matrix Hydrogels Influence Proliferation, Growth Pattern, Migration and Invasion of Breast Cancer Cells
Restricted access: the files of this record are restricted. You may request access to the files in this upload, provided that you fulfil the conditions below.

This dataset contains raw imaging (fluorescence and confocal microscopy), rheology measurements (frequency sweep and stress relaxation tests), and proteomics data generated for the study of how the mechanical properties of adipose tissue decellularized extracellular matrix influence breast cancer cell behavior. It also includes the corresponding processed data, such as GraphPad and Dragonfly session files.
This dataset is intended to complement and extend the information provided in the associated publication (   10.1016/j.bioadv.2026.215243   ). Please cite the publication when using these data.
